title: 8 Things Older Men of God Wish They'd Started at 22
caption:
Ask a man of God in his fifties what he'd do differently at 22. He won't say "hustle harder."

He'll say he wishes he'd read the Bible when nobody was making him. Saved a little out of every check. Found one older man to call. Killed porn before it had twenty years on him. Told his dad what he meant to him.

None of it is complicated. All of it gets harder the longer you wait.

Pick one and start it this week. Then go find an older man and ask him what he'd add.

Save this. Send it to the brother who thinks he has time.

#faith #godlyman #christianmen #mentorship #discipline
